item.title: Logan Thompson felt like he was ‘cursed for a while’ after losing 6 of 7 starts before Blackhawks win
item.description: Logan Thompson came into Friday night’s game between the Washington Capitals and the Chicago Blackhawks just wanting to secure two standings points for the Caps. The 28-year-old backstop had run into a rough patch in an otherwise stellar 2025-26 season, posting a 1-5-1 record in his last seven starts before puck drop at United Center.
